blurb: 礼制明珠 · 爵禄封侯 · 六类工艺 · 舜帝

stops.title: Stop A: Three functions, one pearl
Stop 1: Main entrance — drums, “titles and salaries,” brick stories, door-gods
stops.sceneHook: 正门石鼓 · 砖雕 · 门神

stops.title: Stop 3: Lingnan fruits on the balusters
Stop 4: Hen, chicks, and banana leaves — “great property”
Stop 5: A picture that encourages lifelong study
Stop 6: The rear hall — Emperor Shun at the top

sentences.en: Welcome, everyone.
sentences.zh: 欢迎各位。

sentences.en: Today we visit the Chen Family Temple, also called the Chen Clan Academy — the “Pearl of Lingnan Artistic Architecture” in the heart of Guangzhou.
sentences.zh: 今天我们参观陈家祠，也称陈氏书院——广州城中心的“岭南建筑艺术明珠”。

sentences.en: In the family of Lingnan buildings, it stands among the great ritual / institutional landmarks — alongside places like the Temple of the South China Sea God and Foshan Ancestral Temple — while Kaiping’s watchtowers represent world-heritage vernacular fortresses.
sentences.zh: 在岭南建筑大家族里，它与南海神庙、佛山祖庙等并列，属于重要的礼制建筑；而开平碉楼则代表世界遗产级的民间堡垒建筑。

sentences.en: This place served as a shrine for sacrifices to the common ancestors of the Chen families; as a venue for clannish activities on festive and other special occasions; and as a school for Chen children — hence “Chen Clan Academy.”
sentences.zh: 这里既是陈姓各房祭祀共同祖先的祠堂，也是节庆等特殊场合举行宗族活动的场所，还是陈氏子弟读书的学堂——所以叫“陈氏书院”。

sentences.en: In decoration it gathers the finest Guangdong folk arts and crafts.
sentences.zh: 装饰上，它汇集了广东民间工艺的精华。

sentences.en: From roof to floor, inside and out — columns, eaves, ridges, stairs, doors and windows — you will find stone carvings, brick carvings, lime sculptures, ceramic figurines, wood carvings, and iron-cast artistic pieces.
sentences.zh: 从屋顶到地面，里里外外——柱、檐、脊、阶、门窗——都能见到石雕、砖雕、灰塑、陶塑、木雕和铸铁艺术品。

sentences.en: Motifs carry meaning: the peony for richness and wealth, twin lotus flowers on one stalk for an affectionate couple, and the lion for power and dignity.
sentences.zh: 图案都有寓意：牡丹象征富贵，并蒂莲象征恩爱夫妻，狮子象征威严与权势。

sentences.en: That is why it is called the Pearl of Lingnan Artistic Architecture.
sentences.zh: 因此它被称为岭南建筑艺术明珠。

sentences.en: In 1959 it became the Guangdong Folk Art Museum (also called Guangzhou Folk Art Museum in English materials).
sentences.zh: 一九五九年，这里成为广东民间工艺博物馆（英文材料中也称广州民间工艺博物馆）。

sentences.en: Please stop at the main entrance.
sentences.zh: 请在正门停一下。

sentences.en: Stone drums on both sides symbolize social status.
sentences.zh: 两侧的石鼓象征社会地位。

sentences.en: In feudal Qing society, a family could place drums before the house only when someone had earned the degree of jinshi or higher.
sentences.zh: 在清代封建社会，只有家族中有人考取进士或更高功名，才能在门前摆放石鼓。

sentences.en: Here there is a concrete story: in 1893 — the year before the temple was completed — a clansman named Chen Botao won the rank of tanhua (third place in the palace examination), and these drums were mounted in his honor.
sentences.zh: 这里有个具体故事：一八九三年——祠堂建成前一年——族人陈伯陶 Chen Botao 考中探花（殿试第三名），这些石鼓就是为他而立的。

sentences.en: Please also notice, on the right-hand side behind the stone drum, a relief called “to be conferred a title of nobility” (Jue Lu Feng Hou).
sentences.zh: 请再看石鼓右侧后方的浮雕，叫“爵禄封侯” Jue Lu Feng Hou。

sentences.en: A bird, a deer, a bee, and a monkey appear together: their Chinese names are homonyms for titles of nobility, official salary, and the granting of noble ranks — a wish that Chen descendants would win scholarly honors and high office.
sentences.zh: 雀、鹿、蜂、猴出现在一起：它们的中文名称与爵位、俸禄、封侯谐音——寄托陈氏子孙金榜题名、官运亨通的愿望。

sentences.en: On the walls beside the gate, brick carvings depict different stories from Chinese historical novels — representative works of Guangdong brick-carving.
sentences.zh: 大门两侧墙上的砖雕，刻画了中国历史小说中的不同故事——是广东砖雕的代表作。

sentences.en: On the door leaves are door-gods.
sentences.zh: 门扇上画着门神。

sentences.en: The earliest were legendary Shentu and Yulei, said to catch ghosts and protect the house.
sentences.zh: 最早的门神是传说中的神荼和郁垒，据说能捉鬼护宅。

sentences.en: In fancy armor, rope in hand, they look awe-inspiring.
sentences.zh: 他们身着华丽铠甲，手持绳索，威风凛凛。

sentences.en: Notice an inverted character for happiness / good fortune (fu), often on the reverse of a wood-carving.
sentences.zh: 请注意一个倒着的“福”字，常出现在木雕背面。

sentences.en: In Chinese, “inversion” and “advent” are homophones, so an upside-down fu means “the advent of good fortune” — happiness has arrived.
sentences.zh: 中文里“倒”与“到”谐音，所以倒福意味着“福到了”——幸福已经到来。

sentences.en: At the tops of the balusters are carved southern fruits: peach, star-fruit (carambola), papaya, lychee, and so on — symbolic sacrificial offerings of the choicest Lingnan fruits to the Chen ancestors.
sentences.zh: 栏杆顶端雕着南方水果：桃、杨桃、木瓜、荔枝等——象征把最精美的岭南佳果献给陈氏祖先。

sentences.en: Look at this picture: a hen and chicks foraging under a banana tree.
sentences.zh: 请看这幅图：母鸡带着小鸡在芭蕉树下觅食。

sentences.en: The chickens stand for the present generations; the banana’s big leaves (da ye) sound like “great property” or “great undertaking,” so they suggest the wealth and cause created by past generations.
sentences.zh: 鸡群代表今人；芭蕉的“大叶”与“大业”谐音，暗示先辈开创的财富与事业。

sentences.en: Another picture suggests that a young man may learn quickly, but great learning takes years to shape — like the English proverb “Rome was not built in a day.” It encourages people to study with perennial efforts.
sentences.zh: 另一幅图暗示：年轻人或许学得快，但大学问需要经年累月才能成就——就像英语谚语“罗马不是一日建成的”。它鼓励人们持之以恒地学习。
focusPhrases: “Rome was not built in a day.”

sentences.en: In a clan academy, this message fits perfectly: talent needs time.
sentences.zh: 在宗族书院里，这个道理再贴切不过：成才需要时间。

sentences.en: Finally, the rear hall, where the Chen people worshiped their ancestors.
sentences.zh: 最后是后堂，陈氏族人在此祭祀祖先。

sentences.en: Tablets on the shrine were arranged by seniority; at the highest place was Emperor Shun, believed to be the remote ancestor of the Chen family, with later generations below.
sentences.zh: 神龛上的牌位按辈分排列；最高处是舜帝，被认为是陈氏远祖，后世列于其下。

sentences.en: One pearl, three roles; at the gate — drums of Chen Botao the tanhua, the bird-deer-bee-monkey wish for rank and salary, brick stories and door-gods; inside — six crafts and peony-lotus-lion meanings, inverted fortune, Lingnan fruits, banana “great undertaking,” a picture teaching that learning takes years; and Emperor Shun in the rear hall.
sentences.zh: 一颗明珠，三重功能；门前——探花陈伯陶的石鼓、雀鹿蜂猴祈爵禄、砖雕故事与门神；祠内——六大工艺与牡丹莲狮寓意、倒福、岭南佳果、芭蕉“大业”、劝学需年岁的画，以及后堂的舜帝。

sentences.en: That is the full Chen Family Temple toolkit from the white paper.
sentences.zh: 这就是白皮书中陈家祠的完整工具包。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: I welcome your questions.
sentences.zh: 欢迎提问。
